howto.goal: Play the OpenTTD program you installed yourself, with its own base graphics.
howto.setup: This game is a program on this computer, not a Game Center table.

sections.title: What this screen does
sections.text: This card starts OpenTTD on this computer. Build a transport company and keep it running.

sections.title: Where it runs
sections.text: The program is the one you installed. Game Center only starts it and steps out of the way.

sections.title: Back here
sections.text: Close the program and this page is waiting for you.

controls: Click Play to open the program.
Click Back to leave this card without starting anything.

frames.say: Play opens the program; closing it returns you here.

demo.intro: How OpenTTD opens from Game Center.

frames.say: OpenTTD runs as its own program on this computer.
Game Center starts it and hands over the screen.
Play the game in its own window.
Close the window and this card is here again.

demo.outro: Game Center does not run the game itself — the program you installed does.

steps.say: Click Play to open the program.
Play it in its own window; its own menus do the rest.
Close the program when you are done.
